title: Serialize zc-matrix runs: it started a fresh 3-OS build on every main merge
goal: zc-matrix.yml had no concurrency control: 34 runs in six hours, each a cold 3-OS (linux, macos, windows) build of ~15 min (513 runner-minutes), all failing on the Windows wasmer cranelift compile error. Give it the same policy as Test (a main run is not cancelled by the next merge; GitHub keeps one running and one pending) and a timeout. No cache: three more ~1 GB entries would break the 10 GB quota the Test workflow was just fitted into.
